email.subject: Lighthouse Dentistry's site on mobile
email.body:
Hi Ivy,

I checked Lighthouse Dentistry's website. Two things are likely costing you new patients: it's not set up for mobile, so anyone searching for a dentist on their phone (most people) hits a broken layout and probably just leaves. And the page title doesn't mention "dentist" or "Harbor Falls," so you may be ranking lower than you should in local search.

I fix exactly this kind of thing for a flat fee, no ongoing contract.

Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you what I found and how I'd fix it? No pitch, just the screen.

Alex
Northlight Web
